rules.rule_context:
EXPORT CONTROL NOTICE - Deemed Exports

Controlled technical data (drawings, specifications, process documentation, engineering models) made available to a foreign national inside or outside the U.S. counts as an export to that person's country of nationality under EAR §734.13(b). This applies to shared drives, email, repositories, and any other release method. Citizenship or permanent residency status controls: a U.S. citizen or LPR may receive EAR-controlled technical data without a license. A foreign national (non-U.S.-citizen, non-LPR), including H-1B, L-1, O-1, and similar visa holders, may not be granted access to controlled technical data without an export license or applicable license exception. The license review process runs through Trade Compliance and must be completed before access is provisioned. There is no shortcut for onboarding timelines or project urgency. If you cannot determine whether the data in a folder is EAR-controlled, route the access request to Trade Compliance for classification before any access is granted.
